intro: A second page, driven by the same content layer as the landing page — the proof point that the editor generalizes beyond one page.

sections.heading: One standard
sections.body: WELL brings building-health guidance into a single, coherent standard that teams can actually navigate.

sections.heading: Built for everyone
sections.body: From facilities managers to executives, the standard meets each audience where they are.

sections.heading: Always improving
sections.body: The standard evolves with the evidence — and with feedback from the people who use it every day.
